title: Index Reference Manual
summary: Use Index to search items, recipes, machines, source facts, relations, and addon records.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Index is the system reference. It is best used when the player asks what an item does, where a process comes from, or how a record relates to another system.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Search broad terms first, then filter by category. Use item and recipe links from Wiki rather than trying to remember every path.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Find an item or recipe, inspect its category, read linked entries, then follow source facts or relations until you have a route or crafting plan.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Categories, entries, recipe cards, relations, source facts, diagnostics, and machine layouts make the same information searchable from different angles.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Wiki guide books appear in Index when available. Other addons can add their machines, items, routes, and tutorial records as searchable references.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a record is missing, check that the owning addon is loaded and reopen Index after resources reload.
